title: 第五章 筑基九层十脉第六章 杀王氏兄弟
content_zh:
第五章：筑基九层、十脉原地，柳媚儿脸色极度难看。
她没想到赵月如居然真的答应了苏命的条件。
那可是两百灵石，相当于苏家一个月的收入，苏命这废物怎么配得上这两百灵石？
看着杵在原地的柳媚儿，苏命淡漠道：“怎么，二娘还有事吗？”
回过神，柳媚儿挤出一抹笑意道：“没事，没事。我只是想到你院里的侍卫和侍女都死了，身边也没个服侍的人。这样……老爷回来之前，就让我的侍卫王大和王二来护卫你的安全吧。”
苏命的目光扫过身旁二人，一人筑基八层，另一人气息深沉，是一名气海境修士。
他知道这两人都是柳媚儿的心腹，当即明白，柳媚儿这么做所谓的服侍是假，真正的目的，恐怕还是为了监视、控制自己。
若是以前的苏命，恐怕难以逃脱被掌控、屠戮的命运。
只可惜，他……已经不是他了。
微微一笑，苏命拱手道：“这可是二娘您的护卫，我怎么好夺人所爱？”
“诶，命儿你这说的是什么话，咱们可是母子啊。”柳媚儿皮笑肉不笑地说着。
随后对着王大和王二道：“大公子安危事关重大，你们都过来，我单独给你们交代一些重要的细节。”
将二人叫到院外，柳媚儿脸上那抹和睦瞬间消失，转而挂上了一抹冷冷的怨毒。
“知道我为什么让你们二人来服侍那小混蛋吗？”
王大和王二对视一眼，随后齐齐躬身：“还请夫人明示。”
柳媚儿咬牙切齿道：“管家被绑、照顾苏命的侍女和侍卫接连死亡，种种迹象表明，暗中似乎有人在帮助他。”
体格壮硕一些的王大若有所思道：“所以夫人是让咱们把帮他那人揪出来？”
“不光如此！”柳媚儿冷哼一声道：“必要的时候，你们可以直接把苏命给杀了。”
二人一愣：“可这事儿要是被老爷知道了……”
柳媚儿冷笑道：“真到了那时候，我会给你们一笔钱，你们自此远走他乡。再别回来。”

王大王二目露凶光，齐齐躬身：“属下明白了。”
……
赵月如的办事效率很快，仅仅半日功夫，就派人将苏命需要的灵石送到了后院。
从这一点上看，也能看出赵月如对苏命是多么的嫌弃。
看着手中的一百灵石和一百灵票，苏命自嘲地笑了一声：“苏命啊苏命，你恐怕也想不到，你之前所做出的所有努力，也就只值这两百灵石吧？”
“不过，我不会辜负你的努力，我会用这些灵石变得更强，为你讨回一个公道。”
关上房门，苏命来到床上盘膝坐下，拿出灵石开始修炼。
屋内光华闪耀，随着死神诀运转，灵石之上散发出一道道氤氲光芒，被苏命逐一吸收。
……
一夜过去，次日凌晨。
太阳刚刚升起，床上双目紧闭的苏命猛地睁开了双眼。
一刹那，屋内仿佛强光亮起，一道夺目的神彩自苏命眼底划过。
“轰隆隆！”
苏命体内响起道道如雷鸣般的声音。
content_en:
Chapter 5: With the ninth level of foundation building and the ten veins in place, Liu Meier's face looked extremely ugly.
She didn't expect that Zhao Yueru actually agreed to Su Ming's conditions.
That was two hundred spirit stones, equivalent to the Su family's monthly income. How could a loser like Su Ming deserve these two hundred spirit stones?
Looking at Liu Mei'er who was stuck on the spot, Su Ming said indifferently: "Why, is Er Niang okay?"
After coming back to her senses, Liu Meier squeezed out a smile and said: "It's okay, it's okay. I just thought that the guards and maids in your courtyard are dead, and there is no one around to serve you. In this way... before the master comes back, let my guards Wang Da and Wang Er come to protect your safety."
Su Ming's eyes glanced at the two people beside him. One was on the eighth level of the foundation, and the other was a Qi Sea Realm monk with a deep aura.
He knew that these two people were Liu Meier's confidants, and he immediately understood that Liu Meier's so-called service was false, and the real purpose was probably to monitor and control him.
If it were Su Ming in the past, it would be difficult to escape the fate of being controlled and slaughtered.
It's a pity that he... is no longer him.
Smiling slightly, Su Ming cupped his hands and said, "This is your escort, Er Niang. How can I win people's love?"
"Hey, Ming'er, what are you talking about? We are mother and son." Liu Meier said with a smile.
Then he said to Wang Da and Wang Er: "The safety of the eldest son is of great importance. You all come here, and I will explain some important details to you alone."
After calling the two of them outside the hospital, the harmony on Liu Meier's face instantly disappeared and was replaced by a touch of cold resentment.
"Do you know why I asked you two to serve that little bastard?"
Wang Da and Wang Er looked at each other, then bowed in unison: "Ma'am, please clarify."
Liu Meier gritted her teeth and said: "The housekeeper was kidnapped, and the maids and guards who took care of Su Ming died one after another. There are various signs that someone seems to be helping him secretly."
The stronger Wang Da said thoughtfully: "So Madam, you want us to find the person who helped him?"
"Not only that!" Liu Mei'er snorted coldly: "When necessary, you can kill Su Ming directly."
The two of them were stunned: "But if the master finds out about this..."
Liu Meier sneered: "When that time comes, I will give you a sum of money, and you will go away from home. Don't come back again."
King Wang's eyes flashed fiercely, and they all bowed: "My subordinates understand."
…
Zhao Yueru worked very efficiently. In just half a day, he sent someone to deliver the spiritual stones Su Ming needed to the backyard.
From this point of view, we can also see how much Zhao Yueru dislikes Su Ming.
Looking at the one hundred spirit stones and one hundred spirit tickets in his hand, Su Ming laughed to himself: "Su Ming, Su Ming, you may not have thought that all the efforts you have made before are only worth these two hundred spirit stones, right?"
"However, I will not let down your efforts. I will use these spiritual stones to become stronger and seek justice for you."
After closing the door, Su Ming came to the bed and sat down cross-legged, took out the spirit stone and started practicing.
The room was filled with brilliance, and as the Death Technique was operating, streams of light emitted from the spirit stones, which were absorbed by Su Ming one by one.
…
One night passed and the next morning dawned.
The sun had just risen, and Su Ming, who had his eyes closed on the bed, suddenly opened his eyes.
In an instant, a bright light seemed to light up in the room, and a dazzling light flashed across Su Ming's eyes.
"Boom!"
Thunderous sounds resounded within Su Ming's body.
